Product.description: Master SKU. 1:N CostRecord, PriceHistory, InventorySnapshot, CompetitorObservation, Orders, PriceDecision; N:M Promotion via PromotionProduct.

fields.name: discontinued_date
fields.rule: required iff status=DISCONTINUED; first inactive day, no price/inventory/order rows on/after it

fields.name: list_price
fields.rule: opening base price on first day; <= price_ceiling

fields.name: price_floor_abs
fields.rule: absolute floor = 1.05 x opening unit cost

fields.name: min_margin_pct
fields.rule: margin on NET price after all discounts

AnnualPriceHistory.description: Five years (2021-2025) of annual reference price/cost per SKU with year-over-year % change. Product 1:N (exactly 5 rows).

fields.name: year
fields.rule: 5 consecutive years ending the year before the window

PriceGradient.description: Derived per-SKU gradient of the 5-year history (1:1 with Product). Recomputable from AnnualPriceHistory.

CostRecord.description: One row per SKU per calendar month (append-only history of unit cost). Product 1:N CostRecord; (sku, cost_month) unique.

fields.name: effective_to
fields.rule: last day of month; >= effective_from; no overlap per sku

PriceHistory.description: Daily price ledger (one row per active SKU-day, never overwritten). Product 1:N PriceHistory; PriceDecision 1:N PriceHistory (governing decision).

fields.name: price_date
fields.rule: contiguous per sku within active period

fields.name: applied_promo_ids
fields.rule: pipe-separated Promotion ids; empty if none

CompetitorObservation.description: Competitor price snapshots with source timestamp (observed_at) and ingestion timestamp (captured_at). Product 1:N.

InventorySnapshot.description: Daily end-of-day stock and demand signal per active SKU. Product 1:N.

fields.name: on_order_units
fields.rule: open replenishment quantity at end of day

fields.name: avg_demand_7d
fields.rule: derived: trailing 7-day mean of demand_units (min periods 1)

fields.name: oldest_stock_age_days
fields.rule: derived (FIFO over InventoryLot): age on snapshot_date of the oldest lot still in stock; 0 when no stock

fields.name: slow_moving_units
fields.rule: derived: closing units in lots aged 61-90 days

fields.name: aged_units
fields.rule: derived: closing units in lots older than 90 days

fields.name: stock_age_class
fields.rule: derived: class of oldest_stock_age_days (NO_STOCK when closing_on_hand = 0)

InventoryLot.description: Stock receipt lots (opening balance + every replenishment receipt) used for FIFO inventory age. Product 1:N. Sales consume the oldest lot first.

fields.name: lot_id
fields.rule: LOT-<sku>-YYYYMMDD (receipt date; opening lot is dated before the window)

fields.name: received_date
fields.rule: unique per sku; replenishment lots = InventorySnapshot.units_received days

fields.name: unit_cost
fields.rule: CostRecord unit cost in the receipt month (opening lot: first window month)

fields.name: remaining_units
fields.rule: derived: FIFO units still in stock on the SKU's last active day

Promotion.description: Promotion/coupon header. N:M with Product via PromotionProduct; N:M with itself via PromotionExclusion; 1:N PromotionRule, PromotionEvent.

fields.name: stack_group
fields.rule: COUPON type must be group COUPON

fields.name: status
fields.rule: status as of as_of date; derived from last PromotionEvent

PromotionRule.description: Promotion-specific eligibility/stacking rules. Promotion 1:N (>=1). Global rules are in rules_config.json.

fields.name: rule_value
fields.rule: MIN_STOCK_UNITS: on_hand >= value; EXCLUSIVE: cannot combine; MIN_MARGIN_PCT: net margin >= value

PromotionProduct.description: Bridge for N:M Promotion <-> Product (eligible assortment).

PromotionExclusion.description: Bridge for N:M Promotion <-> Promotion explicit conflicts (e.g. conflicting coupons). Symmetric; stored once with a<b.

PromotionEvent.description: Append-only lifecycle history. Promotion 1:N. DRAFT->SCHEDULED->ACTIVE->ENDED or SCHEDULED->CANCELLED.

Orders.description: Fulfilled order lines per SKU-day-channel. Product 1:N; PriceHistory 1:N; every line priced from the PriceHistory row of its day.

fields.name: order_status
fields.rule: only fulfilled lines are generated (reconcile to units_sold)

fields.name: bundle_order_id
fields.rule: FK BundleOrder; set on the two component lines (one per SKU) of a bundle sale, else empty. Bundle lines: unit_net_price = allocated bundle price, not PriceHistory.net_price

ProductBundle.description: Inventory-clearance bundle: one high-demand (primary) SKU + one aged/slow-moving complementary (secondary) SKU. Every evaluated candidate is stored; rejected ones have status CANCELLED and a rejection_reason (audit trail). Product 1:N (twice); 1:N BundleOrder.

fields.name: secondary_sku
fields.rule: FK Product.sku; slow-moving/aged component; != primary_sku; at most one accepted bundle per pair at a time

fields.name: bundle_discount_pct
fields.rule: configurable; grows with secondary stock age

fields.name: primary_unit_price
fields.rule: = PriceHistory.base_price of primary on created_at date

fields.name: secondary_unit_price
fields.rule: = PriceHistory.base_price of secondary on created_at date

fields.name: combined_cost
fields.rule: derived: unit costs of both SKUs in the valid_from month (CostRecord)

fields.name: valid_to
fields.rule: >= valid_from; <= valid_from + validity - 1; <= last active day of both SKUs

fields.name: bundle_status
fields.rule: CANCELLED iff rejection_reason set; else EXPIRED if valid_to < as_of, DRAFT if valid_from > as_of, else ACTIVE

fields.name: rejection_reason
fields.rule: first failing rule in documented order; empty when accepted

fields.name: primary_avg_demand_30d
fields.rule: derived: mean InventorySnapshot.demand_units of the previous min(30, day) days

fields.name: primary_demand_threshold
fields.rule: category percentile of that metric among live SKUs on created_at date

fields.name: primary_sellable_units
fields.rule: derived: floor(on_hand_units x (1 - reserve)); on_hand = opening + received on created_at date

fields.name: secondary_sellable_units
fields.rule: derived: same for the secondary SKU

fields.name: max_bundle_units
fields.rule: derived: min(primary_sellable_units, secondary_sellable_units); cap on bundles sold

fields.name: secondary_oldest_age_days
fields.rule: derived (FIFO replay): age of the oldest lot of the secondary at created_at

fields.name: secondary_slow_units
fields.rule: derived: secondary units in lots aged 61-90 days at created_at

fields.name: secondary_aged_units
fields.rule: derived: secondary units in lots older than 90 days at created_at

BundleOrder.description: Bundle sales: one row per bundle per day. Each row has exactly two Orders lines (primary and secondary SKU) with the same quantity, so both SKUs' units_sold / InventorySnapshot move. ProductBundle 1:N; Orders 1:2.

fields.name: bundle_id
fields.rule: FK ProductBundle; bundle must be accepted and order_date within [valid_from, valid_to]

fields.name: order_id
fields.rule: FK Orders: line of the primary SKU

fields.name: secondary_order_id
fields.rule: FK Orders: line of the secondary SKU

fields.name: quantity
fields.rule: units of EACH component; cumulative per bundle <= max_bundle_units

fields.name: total_cost
fields.rule: derived: quantity x (unit_cost primary + unit_cost secondary) of the order month

fields.name: aged_units_cleared
fields.rule: derived (FIFO replay): secondary units of this sale taken from lots older than 90 days

PriceDecision.description: Stored decision inputs and outcomes. Product 1:N; N:M Promotion via DecisionPromotion. Weekly review plus off-cycle COST_CHANGE reviews.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.rule: >= valid_from; day before next weekly review or window end

fields.name: price_before
fields.rule: base price in force before decision

fields.name: on_hand_units
fields.rule: stock at decision time (opening + receipts of the day)

fields.name: competitor_obs_id
fields.rule: FK CompetitorObservation considered (fresh min, else freshest stale)

fields.name: gradient_ref_price
fields.rule: expected price from 5-yr gradient at decision date

fields.name: gradient_ceiling
fields.rule: = PriceGradient.gradient_ceiling; applied ceiling = max(min(price_ceiling, gradient_ceiling), effective_floor)

fields.name: candidate_base_price
fields.rule: policy target before step-limit and guardrails

DecisionPromotion.description: Bridge N:M PriceDecision <-> Promotion: every candidate promotion evaluated, with status and reason (eligibility is reproducible from these + rules).
